title: The Court Cartomancer
text: The Court's fortune-teller sits behind a table of black velvet, her eyes painted on her eyelids. She deals three cards face down, slowly, and smiles at the party. Whoever was born under them, she says, may turn one, and see what it has been keeping.

options.label: The Empress's child turns a card, hoping she smiles upon them.

outcomes.text: The Empress, upright, ripe with plenty. A good harvest for the House.
The Empress, reversed, and her painted eyes open, and look straight at them.

options.label: The Hermit's child turns a card, seeking what lies ahead.

outcomes.text: The Hermit, and his lamp shows the road ahead, and what waits on it in the dark.

options.label: Burn her deck. No good comes from cards that keep secrets.

outcomes.text: The cards curl and scream in the fire. The Court will hear of it, and so will something else.
